title: Social Media Project
description: Development of a social network project using React, TailwindCSS and Firebase. The page allows users to register and log in with their Google account, create posts and give likes.

title: Stack Sorted
description: Contribution to an open-source project that categorizes websites, made by Juxtopposed. Through PR #56 I made sidebar and main-grid scrollable for better UX.

title: devLib
description: A library of resources for web developers, made with Astro and TailwindCSS. The project is hosted on Vercel and has a custom domain.
